content:
mila: Heads-up \/ Cumulon sent a pre-sales ask: 48h sandbox POC to match their webhook/callback semantics and token accounting. They emphasized exact field names and retry headers.

rahul: Noted. Their integration expects callbacks to include: X-Req-Id, signature header X-Hub-Sig, and a top-level events array. We can proxy and rewrite our internal callback to match. Main mismatch: they expect HTTP 202 on receipt and an async callback later; our default is synchronous 200.

dave: For parity tests I propose: (1) 1k webhook samples forwarded through proxy, (2) compare payload byte-for-byte after canonicalization, (3) run 2k prompts to measure token multiplier. I can run jobs on staging Dedicated. ETA 20h to prep datasets.

zoe: Product note  pin to model v2-compat for generation tasks. Also call out that our streaming chunk boundaries differ; their consumer drops partial chunks. We'll buffer at proxy and deliver a single final JSON callback to match their consumer contract.

rachel: Security wants: signed callbacks (HMAC SHA256), allowlisted CIDRs, and the SAML metadata for enterprise login. They also asked for our SOC2 subreport and KMS usage summary. I sent their team a link to the questionnaire.

legal: Cumulon requests a POC addendum: 30-day retention, explicit no-secondary-use, and liability limited to POC scope. We can do that; need to confirm purge mechanism and who signs.

mila: Action list: @rahul build callback adapter + signature verification, @dave run parity jobs, @zoe buffer streaming, @rachel collect SOC2 link and CIDRs, @legal draft POC addendum. Cumulon contact: ops@cumulon.com.

rahul: Quick smoke curl for their webhook producer (replace TOKEN):

```
curl -X POST https:\/\/proxy.redwood.dev\/cumulon\/produce \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize payroll run...","callback_url":"https:\/\/cumulon.test\/webhook"}'
```

Proxy will ingest, run model, then POST final JSON to their callback with X-Req-Id preserved and X-Hub-Sig set.

dave: For token accounting: their tokenizer counts hyphenated identifiers differently. Ill compute both token counts and produce a multiplier table; recommend a temporary flat credit for the POC and reconcile after measurement.

rachel: Netops asked for our egress CIDRs: 35.199.64.0\/24, 18.204.32.0\/24. Sent to their firewall team. Also uploaded SOC2_redwood_excerpt.pdf to the drive.

legal: Who owns purge? Well add a tag to all POC data and schedule deletion after 30 days. Please confirm retention toggle for Hosted vs Dedicated.

zoe: Hosted: can enable customer-managed KMS and set retention TTL. Dedicated: we can guarantee local-only logs and run purge job. Ill document both flows in the runbook.

infra-bot: env created: staging-cumulon-poc region=us-west-2 instance=dedicated-small

rahul: Two likely demo talking points: (1) exact webhook shape preservation (show sample before\/after), (2) token multiplier visualization and reconciliation plan. Offer deterministic runs (temp=0) for stricter phrase parity.

mila: Goal: POC live and first parity report within 48h. If SOC2 or IP allowlist stalls, escalate to AE. :thumbsup:
